# External Consumer Install Verification Fixtures

These fixtures prove a synthetic external-consumer shape can import LIMA public
APIs and call the current dry-run kernel surface from the repository checkout.

This is Mode A verification only: subprocess-free import verification. It does
not run `pip install`, build packages, create virtual environments, publish
artifacts, download dependencies, touch public Sparkbot, touch Arc Bot, wire
shells, call models, execute tools, access connectors, persist data, call
networks, open sockets, access devices, wire Robo-OS, control robots, control
drones, or touch physical-world systems.
